description: This file defines core classes and methods for the SmartClient library, including animation handling, canvas drawing, and layout management. It contains class definitions such as 'Animation', 'Canvas', 'Layout', and 'StatefulCanvas', along with their associated methods and properties.

classes.name: Animation

classes.name: SplitPane
